title: What an API key is
summary: A password for programs, and how the owner adds one.
focus: What an API key is and where the owner saves it
content:
## What an AI provider is

Some features use an AI. The tutor, **Generate the course**, **Use AI** and translation all do. The AI runs at a company called a provider. Skrongle can use Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, Mistral, Grok, OpenRouter, or an Ollama-compatible server that you run yourself.

## What an API key is

A program cannot sign in with a face or a fingerprint. It uses an **API key**. This is a long secret text, like a password for programs. You get one from the provider, in your account on its website.

Providers usually charge for use. They bill the account the key belongs to. Keep a key secret, because anyone who has it can spend your money.

## Adding a key

Only the owner adds keys, and they serve every account. In the account menu open **Manage Users**. In the **AI features** card, open a provider and paste the key. It saves as you paste it. It is stored encrypted and never shown again. You will see only the last four characters.

Other accounts do not see the key form. They ask the owner. A feature with no key says so and stays grey.

quiz.correct_answer: A secret text that lets a program use a provider's account

quiz.prompt: Who can add an AI key to Skrongle?
options: Only the person who made a course
quiz.explanation: Only the owner sees the key form. The key then serves every account.

quiz.prompt: After you save a key, the app shows you the whole key again later.
quiz.explanation: The key is stored encrypted and never shown again. Only the last four characters show.
hints: Secrets should not stay on screen.

quiz.prompt: Who does the provider bill for the use of a key?
options: The account the key belongs to
quiz.correct_answer: The account the key belongs to
quiz.explanation: The provider bills the account that made the key. That is why you keep it secret.
hints: Think about whose account made the key.

quiz.prompt: You need an AI key to use Study mode.
quiz.explanation: Courses and the learning modes work without a key. A key is only for the AI features.
hints: Only some features talk to an AI.
